title.zh: 查询域名下所有App录制配置
title.en: Query All App Recording Configurations Under a Domain

descriptions.zh:
先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口查询直播域名下所有APP录制配置。


## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
First obtain the streaming domain name, and then call this operation to query all APP recording configurations under the live streaming domain.


## QPS Limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please make calls at a reasonable frequency.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-record-config --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --page-num 1 --page-size 5 --order asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveRecordConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Order asc --StreamName liveStream0000 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 5 --DomainName 'example.com' --AppName liveApp0000
